title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #9: Tucson to Bisbee, Mt. Wrightson and Miller Peak
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#9" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "Tucson", "Mt. Wrightson", "Mt. Graham", "Nogales", "Miller Peak" and "Bisbee", with a dashed "U.S. MEXICO" border line across the lower part. Vertical light streaks run through the print.
